features_definition: log adjusted rate = log((sum w k / D_opp + 300 x 0.66442 x 0.93) / (R + 300))
log D (the upcoming opponent's factor in the refit; 1 when the team is not in it)

history_rules.elo: every HLTV series since 2025-09-01 (maps with any scoreboard), start 1500, K 24 per series on the map score, updated after each day; the match uses both teams' ratings at the start of its day
history_rules.maps: HLTV maps with exactly 10 players on the scoreboard (all tiers = the full-history view n), dated on or after 2025-09-01 (the study's data start)
history_rules.opponent_adjustment: weekly (Mondays from 2025-10-27) iterative-proportional fit of kills = rounds x exp(mu + player + opponent) on maps strictly before the refit date (420-day window, half-life 120, player prior 300 x mu, opponent prior 1500 x mu, 12 iterations, opponent factors normalised to exposure-weighted mean 1; skipped while fewer than 1,000 rows); a match day uses the latest refit on or before it that exists when the forecast is made
history_rules.opponent_conceded: per map, the kills of the 5 players facing the team, and the map's rounds
history_rules.player: kills / rounds (rounds = both teams' map score), tonight's environment (LAN flag equal to tonight's), headshots on rows whose HS is recorded and not 0 with 12+ kills, map count (unweighted)
history_rules.team_rounds: per map and team, the map's total rounds; rounds per map = (sum w rounds + 21.74 x 10) / (sum w + 10)
history_rules.window: map day in [match day - 420, match day), weight exp(-(match day - map day) / 120); match day = the UTC date of the scheduled start

mean_model.family: Poisson regression, log link (sklearn PoissonRegressor, alpha 1e-4)

missing_data.no full-scoreboard map in the 420-day wi: zero history sums (prior only) and opponent factor 1, as the study; a player with no full-scoreboard map since 2025-09-01 is ineligible

never: a live input: no projection, chance, grade or stake changes

training.target: Maps 1-2 kills of player-series with both maps on a full (10-player) HLTV scoreboard, matches 2025-11-01 .. 2026-10-16

uncertainty_model.note: NOT Poisson variance: the Poisson regression gives the MEAN only. The study scored every model with a discretised normal whose sd scales with sqrt(lambda) by a factor re-estimated on the training residuals: c^2 = mean((y - lambda)^2 / lambda).
uncertainty_model.push: half-point line: P(Over) = 1 - Phi((floor(line) + 0.5 - lambda) / sd); whole line: P(Over) / (P(Over) + P(Under)) with P(Over) = 1 - Phi((line + 0.5 - lambda) / sd), P(Under) = Phi((line - 0.5 - lambda) / sd) - the push is excluded, as live p_more
